newsitem.title: UK: NWE gas oil steady amid steady futures, premiums.
newsitem.headline: NWE gas oil steady amid steady futures, premiums.

text.p: NWE gas oil was broadly steady with premiums holding and futures unchanged.
April IPE gas oil closed up 25 cents at $172.50 a tonne.

Attention was still focused on the continued draw of European gas oil eastwards following a 140,000 tonne cargo seen fixed on tanker for a Rotterdam to Singapore trip yesterday. Traders said a similar sized cargo may also be done over the next few days.
Russian cargoes were pegged steady around April IPE +$2-3 cif NWE for first half April while DIN was bid at +$4.50 and offered for Hamburg only at +$3 for 1-10 dates.
FOD remains difficult to track because of a lack of liquidity, but put notionally around April IPE +$2.50.

Diesel was steady or even a touch firmer with a cargo sold very prompt at April IPE +$14.25 basis Bordeaux which traders said was about the equivalent of April IPE +$12 basis Le Havre. The strong price reflected the promptness of the cargo.
